name: Claude Concept Promo
description:
A 39-second cinematic concept promo for Claude. It moves from digital noise to clarity, with a natural voiceover, a fully synced sound mix and Claude's warm coral-and-cream palette.

Too many tabs, too many drafts, too many ideas. This spot opens on a dark crosshair full of scattered thoughts, then pulls everything together into one calm moment: understood.

From there it moves through what Claude does. A prompt typed on a frosted-glass beach scene, an image burst that comes together into Done., and a glassy Mac-style code window that finds a bug and fixes it live. Then a tree of ideas grows and branches out, before landing on the end card: Room to think. To build. To wonder.

What's inside:

10 shots with camera dives, push-ins and pans timed to every beat
A Liquid Glass code window with live error-to-fix animation
A custom burst of images that flies into the word "Done."
An animated idea tree with labelled branches
An American voiceover synced line by line to the vi
